question: Who makes Kaizer avocado oil brand
markdown:
Kaizer avocado oil is an in-house brand manufactured and marketed by
Lumont Ventures Private Limited
, based in Faridabad, Haryana, India. The oil itself is cold-pressed and processed from single-origin, hand-picked avocados sourced from the highlands of Kenya
. You can explore their product range directly on the
⁠Kaizer Official Website
